六级大纲词汇 · 02英文原文

The Fence That Moved

挪过位置的围栏 · 586 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1At the edge of a barren meadow, Lin found a turtle nest with no offspring. The owner of a ranch blamed the hawk above his reservoir and proposed an enclosure. A shepherd tended the livestock grazing on the pasture that provided the owner's subsistence. On a conservation survey, Lin promised an affordable intervention before he enclosed the tract. She had seen the bird there for years. The nests had declined only that spring.

2In a clearing by a cluster of oaks, a thorny shrub tore her sleeve. A thorn caught on a remnant of shell. The shell bore no marks from a beak. A spongy mat held stagnant water like a sponge. An erosive channel led from the adjacent poultry barn into the swamp. By a stump, a snail climbed from water left to stagnate. Beetles that once sheltered there had vanished. The smell of rot suggested wider degradation.

3The rancher wanted pesticide to repel mosquitoes. Lin asked for a test before taking any chemical counteraction. It revealed that runoff carried a toxic treatment for a poultry parasite. To eradicate a pest would do nothing about that trickle. The bank would degrade further as the roots withered. A botany teacher showed how indigenous vegetation could counteract erosion and keep the current from cutting deeper. Without it, heavy rain would deplete the soil around each nest.

4Rather than mow the verge, they diverted the runoff and began to nurture hardy plants there. A botanical club agreed to propagate several shrubs and provide edible herbs for a dry patch. Herb sales and a hive by the predominant flowering shrub could make the scheme viable. The rancher moved his herd but left a gap at the fence, where young turtles could reach a sanctuary among the shrubbery. A sign kept the next worker from blocking the route.

5Evaporation lowered the water that summer. After storms the shallow pool was no longer prone to stagnation under a multitude of stalks. A crow came to peck at the mud. An owl perched beyond the fence. Insects could hibernate in the standing stems. After hibernation a spider spread a web where mosquitoes had once predominated. Lin took notes. A tranquil surface could hide ecosystem damage.

6A camera showed a young turtle cross the gap. The next clip showed the hawk catch a mouse approaching the nest. The bird was a predator, but its prey included animals that might devour turtle eggs. Driving it away would be to the detriment of the new brood. Lin showed the rancher both clips. He could now see why a predatory bird and the turtles could coexist and why a wire barrier would have addressed the wrong cause.

7By spring the vegetation had recovered from depletion after years of extraction from the reservoir. Storms could no longer erode the banks so quickly. He asked if the turtles could still become extinct. Lin said coexistence looked possible. The risk of extinction was smaller. An exotic predator or a new chemical leak could still harm the meadow. If the numbers began to diminish, they would check the flow from the barn and the roots along the water.

8They moved the fence a few meters uphill to conserve the strip. Lin painted a turtle on the gate beside a small arrow. It marked the path that nobody should close. A visitor asked what it meant. The rancher pointed past the shrub where the hawk still perched. The fence now protected the route across the meadow rather than cutting it off.

六级大纲词汇 · 02中文译文

挪过位置的围栏

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1在一片贫瘠草地的边缘，林发现了一个没有幼龟的龟巢。牧场主把原因归到水库上空的一只鹰身上，打算围起岸边。牧人照看着在草场吃草的牲畜，牧场主一家就靠这片草场生活。林正在做一项保护调查。她答应在整片地被围起来前，找出牧场主负担得起的办法。她见那只鹰在这里待了好几年，龟巢却是当年春天才开始减少的。

2在一片橡树旁的空地上，带刺的灌木扯破了林的袖子。一根刺挂住了一片残壳，壳上没有鸟喙留下的痕迹。一团海绵状的东西吸住了积水。旁边的家禽棚与沼泽之间有一道被水冲出来的沟。林看见一只蜗牛在树桩旁爬出久滞的水洼。原先在这里躲藏的甲虫已经不见了。腐烂的气味说明，受损的地方恐怕远不止一个龟巢。

3牧场主想喷洒杀虫剂驱赶蚊子。林请他在采取任何化学措施前先做一次检测。结果表明，地表径流带来了用于处理家禽寄生虫的有毒药剂。消灭一种害虫也堵不住那股细流。草根一旦枯萎，岸坡还会继续退化。一位植物学老师解释，本地植被能抵消一部分冲刷，避免沟被切得越来越深。没有植被，每场大雨都会带走龟巢附近的土。

4他们疏导了径流，在路缘培育耐寒植物，保留那里的野草。一家植物社团答应繁育几种灌木，还给干燥地块提供食用香草。卖香草，再在主要的开花灌木旁放个蜂箱，或许能让方案维持下去。牧场主转移了牛群，但在围栏留了一个缺口，小龟可以钻过去，躲进灌木丛。他们立了牌子，提醒来干活的人留着这条路。

5那年夏天，蒸发使水位下降。暴雨过后，浅水洼已经不容易因堆满茎秆而变成死水。一只乌鸦飞来啄泥，一只猫头鹰栖在围栏外。昆虫能在留下的茎秆里越冬。越冬期一过，一只蜘蛛在原先蚊子成群的地方织起了网。林一一记下变化。水面看起来平静，也可能掩盖生态系统的损伤。

6相机拍到一只幼龟穿过缺口。下一段画面里，鹰抓住了一只正接近龟巢的老鼠。鹰是捕食者，可它的猎物中也包括可能吞吃龟蛋的动物。把鹰赶走，对这窝小龟反而不利。林把两段画面都给牧场主看。他终于明白，猛禽和龟能够共存，一道铁丝围栏本会挡错对象。

7到了春天，植被从水库多年取水造成的损耗中恢复了过来。暴雨冲刷岸坡的速度也慢了。牧场主问，这些龟还有没有灭绝的危险。林说，现在看来共存可行，灭绝的风险比以前小了。外来捕食者或新的化学品泄漏仍然可能危害草地。以后龟巢再减少，他们知道该先看什么了，就是家禽棚流出来的水和岸边的根系。

8为了保护这片地，他们把围栏往坡上挪了几米。林在门上画了一只龟，旁边画了个小箭头，提醒人们别堵住这条路。一位访客问箭头是什么意思。牧场主指向一株灌木，越过那株灌木，还能看见那只鹰停在那里。如今，围栏给穿过草地的动物留出了通道。
